entities.summary: Sipke Taeke Castelein is a retired Dutch rower. He competed at the 1964 Summer Olympics in the coxless fours, together with Jim Enters, Herman Boelen, and Sjoerd Wartena, and finished in fourth place. He won a silver medal in the coxed pair at the 1963 European Championships.
